**Daily Devotional**

**June 27**

*27 To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory: (Colossians 1:27 KJV)*

It is so awesome that Christ lives in us Saints (Galatians 4:6). It is something that us humans have difficulty understanding, as we can not grasp the fact that Christ can live inside all the born again believers. This verse is saying that God wishes us to know the full glory of what it means to have Christ live within us. All Christians should study the Word of God (Romans 12:2), and try to get hold of just what all it means, as we have such power inside us, that we can tap into, and do the works that Jesus did while on earth (John 14:12).

The average Christian does not even begin to understand what having Christ in us, really means. We have the same power living in us that God used to raise Jesus from the dead after 3 days (Ephesians 1:19-20). Wow, that should be enough to take care of our needs, if we could just get the understanding of how to tap into that power. I believe that we will truly be shocked when it is finally revealed what the Glory of the power is, that we already have living within us (Romans 8:18). God is so good to provide us with His Spirit, and we need to try and make use of it in this world, and not just wait for the Kingdom that is coming soon. Shine your light out into this dark world (Matthew 5:16).

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
